title: Machine Learning-Guided Discovery of Novel Inhibitors of Escherichia coli MurB.
authors: Song, Shuhua; Liu, Qingxin; Luo, Aoqi; Shi, Xiao; Si, Xinxin
one_liner_zh: 该文用机器学习模型和分子对接筛选E. coli MurB抑制剂，并结合MD模拟分析结合稳定性，属于蛋白质-配体对接和MD的工程化应用，方法创新性一般，但涉及蛋白质结构计算。
abstract: MurB, a key enzyme involved in bacterial cell wall biosynthesis, represents a promising target for antibacterial drug discovery. In this study, a machine learning assay was employed to identify potential inhibitors targeting E. coli MurB. Five machine learning models were constructed using AutoMolDesigner, of which the RDKit_2D-based Model_2 was selected as the optimal activity-prediction model for virtual screening of an in-house compound library, yielding 238 compounds. These compounds were subsequently subjected to FRED molecular docking, and 16 candidate compounds were selected based on their hydrogen-bond interactions with the key active-site residue ASN A:233. Preliminary enzyme inhibition assays conducted at 50 muM identified 4 compounds (Q9, Q11, Q12, and Q13) with inhibition rates exceeding 50%. Further IC(5)(0) determination revealed values of 34.44, 31.45, 25.08, and 25.94 muM, respectively. Molecular dynamics simulations combined with principal component analysis were performed to investigate the dynamic behaviors and binding stability of the MurB-ligand complexes. In addition, a CCK-8 assay was conducted in HepG2 cells to evaluate the cytotoxicity of the active compounds preliminarily. Collectively, 4 low-cytotoxic micromolar MurB inhibitors were identified in this study, offering promising scaffolds for further mechanistic investigation and structural optimization.
abstract_zh: MurB是参与细菌细胞壁生物合成的关键酶，代表了抗菌药物发现的一个有前景的靶点。本研究采用机器学习测定方法，以识别靶向大肠杆菌MurB的潜在抑制剂。使用AutoMolDesigner构建了五种机器学习模型，其中基于RDKit_2D的Model_2被选为最优活性预测模型，用于内部化合物库的虚拟筛选，共获得238种化合物。这些化合物随后经过FRED分子对接，根据与关键活性位点残基ASN A:233的氢键相互作用，筛选出16种候选化合物。在50 μM浓度下进行的初步酶抑制测定中，鉴定出4种化合物（Q9、Q11、Q12和Q13）的抑制率超过50%。进一步的IC(5)(0)测定显示其值分别为34.44、31.45、25.08和25.94 μM。结合主成分分析的分子动力学模拟被用于研究MurB-配体复合物的动态行为和结合稳定性。此外，在HepG2细胞中进行了CCK-8测定，以初步评估活性化合物的细胞毒性。总体而言，本研究鉴定出4种低细胞毒性的微摩尔级MurB抑制剂，为后续机制研究和结构优化提供了有前景的骨架。
